theorems.name: Submission.iwl_rl_restriction_cutoff_estimate
theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U W : Set (Eucl P)) (φ : Eucl P → ℝ) (a s c : ℝ) (Y S : GeometricCurrentOn U k) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (ω ω' : TestFormOn U k), IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → ContinuousOn φ U → a < s → IsRestriction Y {x | x ∈ U ∧ φ x < s} S → (∀ (A : Set (Eucl P)) (S' : GeometricCurrentOn U k), IsRestriction Y A S' → ∀ W' : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen W' → W' ⊆ U → S'.massOn W' = μ (W' ∩ A)) → Y.massOn W < ∞ → (∀ x ∈ U, s ≤ φ x → (ω' : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) x = 0) → tsupport ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) - (ω' : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k)) ⊆ {x | x ∈ W ∧ a < φ x} → (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) x - (ω' : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) x) ≤ c) → |S ω - Y ω'| ≤ c * ((Y.massOn {x | x ∈ W ∧ φ x < s}).toReal - (Y.massOn {x | x ∈ W ∧ φ x < a}).toReal)
